# SEG Printing

> SEG Printing (part of Event Production Supply) prints SEG (silicone edge graphics) tension fabric in Singapore for backlit LED lightboxes, trade show booths, brand backdrops, counters and exhibition walls.

- Location: Singapore (delivery island-wide)
- Price: SEG fabric printing from S$45 per square metre (SGD)
- Services: dye-sublimation fabric printing with sewn silicone edge; backlit and front-lit fabric; reprints for existing SEG frames; proof before print
- Process: send artwork and sizes -> proof -> print -> delivery
- Frames: LED lightbox frames for rent or sale via Lightbox Singapore (https://lightboxasia.com/)
- Contact: Ian James, Event Production Supply, ianjames@eventproduction.supply
